title: Qullunakar Mayacht’asir Aru
intro: Mä cheqapar sarnaqer almarojj alajjpachatwa wali muspharkañ regalonak churapjjäna, mä apnaqeriru ukat nuwasir jaqëjjänwa, jupajj pachpa luräwinakampis mayachtʼatäkaspas ukhamänwa. Jupanakan sarnaqäwipax profecía, rey, artesanía ukanakamp sawutawa, mä herencia jaytawayi, ukax Diosan qhanañchäwipan pankanakapanw ist’asi.
clues: Nayax Allahan luqtiripat ajllitätwa ukat mä ajllit marka taypin mä jach’a reino churarakitu.
Qullunakas jamach’inakas nayamp chikaw ist’asipxirïna, Altu pataru jach’añchañataki.
Hierrox amparanakajan laq’ar uñtat llamp’uruw tukuwayi, Allah sapak munatapata.
Nayajj jarkʼaqasiñ armaduranak lurayäta, uka armadurajj nuwasiñanakan wali juntʼüpkäna ukhajj nuwasir jaqenakaruw jarkʼaqäna.
Mä kutejja, mä chʼama yantʼaruw pasawayta, kunapachatï pä chʼajjwirinakaw Diosar yupaychañ utajar jan suytʼat mantapjjäna.
Nayax mä apnaqirimp chikaw arsusipxitu, jupax thayaru ukhamarak jinq’unakaruw kamachi — kunatix uka apnaqirix nayan pachpa wawanakajapunïnwa.

trial.label: Yant’awi/Evento
options: Pä chʼaxwirinakaw Diosar yupaychañ utajar mantapxäna
Mä jachʼa uma jalsumpiw uñjasiyäta, uka umajj markajaruw tʼunjäna
Taqi familian ukhamarak qamir yänakap chhaqhayañampiw yant’ata
trial.answer: Pä chʼaxwirinakaw Diosar yupaychañ utajar mantapxäna

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa
options: Mä thujru, ukax mä katariruw tukuwayi
Mä jach’a jardina pä kasta achunakampi

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Mä challwa purakapat qhispiyata ukat jaqinakax iyawsapxäna
Markajarojj mä tirano jaqen amparapat qhespiyawayta

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْمَلْ سَـٰبِغَـٰتٍۢ وَقَدِّرْ فِى ٱلسَّرْدِ ۖ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
verse: [Commanding him], "Make full coats of mail and calculate [precisely] the links, and work [all of you] righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Seeing." (34:11)
